items.title: PLAN-services §4 step 8.4: the ## Research id rules in setup plans (blocked on step 8.2)
items.evidence: Dispatched 2026-10-15 (coordinator, relayed as Jacob's 2026-10-12 approval of PLAN-services §4). Not built: §4 step 8 is 'in this order' and step 8.2 (the research CLI, R2 shape, R6 depth field) is not done: tools/research holds only its scaffold (dev.sh, devtools/parts.py; no CLI, no rs- index). No plan in the workspace carries an rs- id, and the Decisions sections are prose, not rows. Building it now would mean inventing the resolver's interface (e.g. 'research show <id> --json' -> {state: open|answered, depth: quick|full}) and the Decisions-row grammar, with no live test possible: a seam that cannot be gated. Proposed when 8.2 lands: 'setup plans <dir> --research CLI' (as --steps takes --todo CLI); without it every rs- id is a note 'unchecked', never a pass; with it an unresolved id, and an rs- id cited under a plan's ## Decisions that is open or answered only at quick, FAIL (fixtures both ways, a fake research CLI, a live test against the real one, a mutant).
items.done_when: setup plans refuses a Decisions row resting on an rs- id answered only at quick, proven both ways against the real research CLI
items.resolution: built: setup plans checks the Research id rules (setuplib/rsids.py): rs-<n> -- <question> grammar, every id listed and resolved with the research dependency's get --json, a Decisions row on an open or quick-only id fails; no CLI is UNCHECKED exit 3. tests/test_research_ids.py runs the real CLI on a scratch store; 9 mutants

items.title: td-9 (tools/todo: `devtools/mutate.py` duplicated from here), decided 2026-10-04: the runner moves to tools/checks, not into a setup component.
items.evidence:
A
component would install one copy per repo, the eight-copies problem again; the
procedure belongs in one place and each repo's `devtools/mutants.json` is the
data. Shape: `checks mutants [PATH]` running PATH's mutants.json in throwaway
copies, with todo's additions (the `edits` list, the read-only chmod). Then
this repo and todo call it from `dev.sh check` and delete their copies, add
beside then delete. Until then this copy is the original and todo's the
extended one; neither is changed (no fork, no third copy). Needs the
dependency decision above for setup's own `dev.sh` to call it. Reported below.
items.resolution: superseded 2026-10-19: the shape built is a setup component (mutate, f861939, 2026-10-17), and Jacob approved su-74 (2026-10-19), whose done-when is 'one copy, installed by setup'. This item was an agent's call (approved: null), never his; no checks mutants verb was built. Forward drift of rendered copies: su-105

items.title: kb-pointers cannot be proposed today: the workspace top is not a git repo, and setup refuses it
items.evidence:
(run 2026-10-04 from the top: `setup . --dry-run --plugins
<(...)` -> "refused: ... is not empty, and is not a git work tree"). kb-pointers is
`repos:.`, the top only. The `--plugins` machinery is proven with the live registry
re-rooted at a scratch repo (the proposal held exactly its `registration`). Needs a
decision, not built: a settings-only mode for a non-repo folder (only the hooks
component, the proposal written, nothing else), or the dispatcher/harness writes
the top's proposal from `hooks plugins --json` directly. Hinges on whether setup
should ever touch a folder that is not a repo.
items.resolution: Decided by Jacob's ruling (PLAN-services §3 F3 step 3 (a), approved 2026-10-12; su-77 typed yes 2026-10-20): setup writes no proposal at the top; the top's registrations, plugins included, come through wiring.json. Built in 17f8091: --plugins at the top is refused, no proposal written (tests/test_subrepo.py, mutants red).
